candidate_A.change: Merge hash_return/output_return/verify_return into state_t continuation; retain all state codes and transitions
candidate_A.risk: Merged write mux and downstream decode can offset the few saved FF; area must be measured
lifetime_proof: start_hash writes continuation and enters HASH_ISSUE on the same edge. HASH_ISSUE only goes to HASH_WAIT; no other return producer occurs before HASH_WAIT consumes lane_valid.
P1 scalar recipe reads external request_right during several internal hash phases; continuation stays unchanged during the entire HASH_ISSUE/HASH_WAIT interval, preserving parent_right.
P>1 scalar fixed bridge samples right node on accepted request. Continuation remains valid at that acceptance edge.
start_output writes continuation before OUTPUT_CHUNK. Multi-beat direct captures keep the PIPE_CAPTURE_NEXT sentinel stable until advance_direct_batch retires the last beat.
read_verify_node writes continuation before VERIFY_INPUT. The node acceptance edge consumes it before a later state may start another hash/output/input operation.
Reset initializes continuation to IDLE, retaining old verify_return reset. Old hash_return/output_return were uninitialized but cannot be consumed before start_hash/start_output assigns them.
No task nests a hash wait inside an output/input wait, or starts output/input while the scalar hash is in flight; return validity follows serial state phases, not merely algorithm exclusivity.

not_redundant.reason: Live P1 scalar L-tree path; P>1 compile-time pruning does not make them globally dead.
One read/setup cycle before issuing binary hash; RAM prefetch and public-context handoff occur here. Cannot remove just because main case only transitions.
Serializes auth-before-stack writes sharing one RAM write port. Two simultaneously live data values cannot collapse into one write.
Required odd67-node L-tree tail move and layer advance. Hash wait and copy share case body but have different RAM actions.
Request acceptance, response capture, endpoint write and ordered signature capture occur at separate edges. One shared state needs extra phase flags; deleting stages changes protocol or cycles.
